Repeated company language that it "is not able to estimate a possible loss or range of possible loss" for the Combat Arms litigation and other environmental matters beyond the recorded accrual is itself a disclosed risk factor — it signals that actual outcomes could exceed booked reserves, but the filings stop short of any adequacy conclusion. This is a judgement the indexed filings do not support, and it is flagged for human review rather than asserted.</draft>

This is a judgement the indexed filings do not support, and it is flagged for human review rather than asserted.</draft>
